# MEET THE GROWERS [italic]Forty two members, three colonies, one tray at a time. A few of them agreed to be written about.[/italic]
## MARGIT OYELARAN, HOPE'S RETREAT Founding member and chair, re-elected six times, mostly because nobody else wants the paperwork. Margit grew the first plant in the corner of the bay in 2176 from seed she had carried in her boot through two hypersleep cycles. She will not say where the seed came from.
## FRANCIS DUBE, SHEPHERDS' PRIDE Grows River Dark in the damp end of the Shepherds' Pride bay, near the fishery. Swears the fish in the air make the leaf stronger. The co-op has never tested this and has decided not to.
## YUKI ABERNATHY-SOL, SOLARIS RIDGE The youngest member, at nineteen, and the only grower on a colony of one hundred and twenty people. Grows four trays, carves no pipes, but sells the pipes her grandfather carves. Says Solaris Ridge is quiet. Says she likes it that way.
## JOE 7 A Seegson Working Joe on loan to the Hope's Retreat bay. Joe 7 waters the trays on the night shift and has never missed a plant. The co-op voted to make Joe 7 an honorary member. Joe 7 cannot vote, does not smoke and does not want a share of the profits, which the co-op agrees makes Joe 7 its best member.
## HOW TO JOIN - You need spare tray capacity, the approval of your colony administration and of your hydroponics lead. - The co-op sends seed and a curing guide with the next freighter. - The co-op buys your cured leaf at a fair price, set by vote every season. - Food trays first. Always. A member who takes a food tray for leaf is out.
Write to the co-op, care of the Hope's Retreat hydroponics bay. Margit reads every letter, eventually.
